description: Assembly source code for cryptographic functions optimized with AVX2 instructions, generated from a Perl script in the BoringSSL project. Contains implementations for squaring, multiplication, reduction, normalization, and gather/scatter operations related to RSA-1024 cryptography.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_sqr_avx2
methods.description: Function for squaring 1024-bit RSA operands using AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_mul_avx2
methods.description: Function for multiplying 1024-bit RSA operands using AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_red2norm_avx2
methods.description: Reduces a 1024-bit number to a normalized form using AVX2 instructions.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_norm2red_avx2
methods.description: Converts a normalized number back to a reduced form for RSA operations.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_scatter5_avx2
methods.description: Performs scatter operation for 1024-bit RSA data using AVX2.

methods.name: _rsaz_1024_gather5_avx2
methods.description: Performs gather operation for 1024-bit RSA data using AVX2.
